maintenance.details: Sensor was intermittently dropping; replaced and re-aligned bracket. Verified I/O in PLC.

Cleaned arc chute area, inspected contacts, performed secondary injection test.
Replaced intake filter and oil separator; topped up oil to spec. Checked for leaks.
Observed minor weep at seal; scheduled seal replacement next outage window.
Customer reported intermittent test failures; updated PLC debounce logic and provided new procedure.

machines.name: Packaging Line 2 Conveyor
machines.description: Critical carton-transfer conveyor between case packer CP-02 and palletizer PL-02. Rated for 1,200 cartons/hour with three accumulation zones and one 18 m modular belt. Commissioned 2021-08-14; owner: Packaging; criticality: High; PM cadence: monthly inspection and quarterly drive service. Isolate MCC-L2-07 and release pneumatic stops before work.
machines.location: Plant A / Packaging Hall / Line 2 / Zone P2-04

installed_parts.notes: Drive station DS-02; 25.8:1 ratio; normal motor current 3.6-4.1 A.
Panel MCC-L2-07; parameter backup CONV-L2-2026-06 is the approved baseline.
Sensors PE-201 through PE-206 cover infeed, accumulation, and discharge zones.
18 m endless belt; inspect hinge rods monthly and replace at 10% link damage.
Head-shaft bearings BRG-DS and BRG-NDS; grease with NSF H1 every quarter.

maintenance.details: Locked out MCC-L2-07, inspected all belt hinge rods and wear strips, lubricated both head-shaft bearings, and checked gearbox leakage. Belt damage measured below 2%; bearing temperatures stabilized at 43 C drive side and 41 C non-drive side after restart.

PE-206 intermittently dropped carton presence because its lens seal had failed. Replaced the sensor, set the reflector margin to 62%, realigned the bracket, and completed 200-carton verification with zero missed counts. Line downtime was 47 minutes.

maintenance.summary: Adjusted belt tracking and inspected drive train
maintenance.details: Corrected a 9 mm discharge-side belt drift, squared the tail shaft, verified sprocket alignment, and torqued bearing fasteners to 48 Nm. Gearmotor vibration was 2.1 mm/s RMS, below the 4.5 mm/s alert limit.

maintenance.summary: Resolved VFD overcurrent trips at palletizer handoff
maintenance.details: Trend data showed current spikes when accumulation zone 3 released a full queue. Freed a sticking pneumatic stop, restored the approved VFD acceleration ramp from 0.8 s to 1.5 s, and saved a new parameter backup. Peak current fell from 7.9 A to 5.2 A across 20 loaded starts.

machines.name: Unit 3 Switchgear Breaker
machines.description: Primary 13.8 kV vacuum feeder breaker supplying Unit 3 process loads from lineup SG-3. Rated 1,200 A with 25 kA interrupting duty. Commissioned 2019-05-22; owner: Electrical; criticality: Safety Critical; PM cadence: annual outage service plus quarterly visual and thermographic inspection. Arc-flash boundary is 3.7 m; follow the approved switching order and verify absence of voltage before racking.
machines.location: Plant A / Substation U3 / Lineup SG-3 / Cubicle 3B

installed_parts.notes: Phase A-C pole assemblies; 2025 contact-wear readings: 1.1, 1.0, and 1.2 mm.
Protection profile U3-FDR-R5; settings changes require Electrical Engineering approval.
Spring-charge motor M1; replaced 2026-03-07 after insulation resistance declined.
Closing coil Y1; measured resistance 188 ohm at the 2025 annual PM.
Trip coil Y2; measured resistance 176 ohm at the 2025 annual PM.

maintenance.details: Scanned the closed cubicle at 78% feeder load. Maximum phase-to-phase temperature delta was 2.4 C at the upper stabs, below the 10 C alert threshold. No abnormal heating was found at control-power terminals.

maintenance.summary: Annual outage PM and secondary-injection test
maintenance.details: Breaker was isolated, racked to test, cleaned, lubricated, and inspected. Contact resistance measured 31, 29, and 32 micro-ohm. Secondary injection confirmed long-time, short-time, instantaneous, and ground-fault pickup within tolerance. Trip time was 52 ms.

The motor stalled intermittently at the end of charge. Insulation resistance was 1.8 Mohm versus the 10 Mohm minimum. Replaced M1, verified limit-switch timing, and completed 25 close-open cycles. Charge time improved from 19.4 s to 8.7 s.

maintenance.summary: Verified feeder protection settings and trip circuit
maintenance.details: Compared active settings against approved profile U3-FDR-R5, tested remote and local trip paths, verified 125 VDC control supply at 128.4 V, and checked trip-circuit supervision. No deviations or alarms were found.

machines.name: Air Compressor #4
machines.description: Lead 30 kW variable-speed rotary screw compressor serving the 7.5 bar plant-air header. Nominal capacity is 5.4 m3/min with automatic lead-lag rotation across four units. Commissioned 2022-03-10; owner: Utilities; criticality: High; service interval: 4,000 run hours with weekly condensate and leak checks. Isolate 480 VAC, close the discharge valve, and vent receiver pressure before service.
machines.location: Plant A / Utilities Building / Compressor Room / Pad C4

installed_parts.notes: Change at 4,000 run hours or at 45 mbar differential pressure.
Installed with food-grade synthetic compressor lubricant.
Replace at 8,000 hours or when separator differential exceeds 0.8 bar.
Air-end outlet sensor TT-AC4-01; high-temperature trip setpoint 110 C.
Drain CD-AC4; weekly test button check and quarterly strainer cleaning.

maintenance.details: Changed intake and oil filters, sampled lubricant, cleaned the cooler, checked electrical terminals, and inspected hoses. Loaded discharge temperature was 86 C and specific power was 6.3 kW per m3/min after service.

Separator differential reached 0.84 bar at full load and oil carryover was visible downstream. Replaced the separator element and vessel O-ring, leak-tested the cover, and confirmed 0.21 bar differential at 7.5 bar discharge.

Unit alarmed at 104 C during peak demand. Cooler face was 60% obstructed by packaging dust. Vacuumed and washed the cooler, verified fan rotation, and checked the PT100 against a calibrated probe. Full-load temperature dropped to 88 C.

maintenance.summary: Cleaned condensate drain and verified zero-loss cycle
maintenance.details: A slow drain cycle was reported during the weekly route. Removed rust scale from the inlet strainer, flushed the valve, and completed ten demand cycles with no compressed-air loss. No production interruption was required.

machines.name: Boiler Feed Pump B
machines.description: Automatic standby vertical multistage pump supplying Boiler 1 feedwater when Pump A is unavailable. Rated 42 m3/hour at 11.5 bar and 90 C with a 30 kW motor. Commissioned 2020-11-02; owner: Utilities; criticality: High; PM cadence: monthly auto-start, quarterly vibration route, and annual alignment check. Isolate the motor starter and both suction and discharge valves before opening the pump.
machines.location: Plant A / Boiler House / Feedwater Skid / Position B

installed_parts.notes: Seal position MS-B; last replaced 2026-03-02 with flush plan verified clear.
Matched motor bearing set; relubricate every 2,000 run hours.
Coupling insert CI-B; inspect for cracking during annual laser alignment.
Motor M-BFP-B; 400 VAC; full-load current 54 A; insulation class F.
Transmitter PT-BFP-B; control range 0-16 bar; calibration due 2027-03.

maintenance.details: Completed automatic failover from Pump A and ran Pump B for 30 minutes at 39 m3/hour. Peak vibration was 2.7 mm/s RMS at the motor drive end and seal leakage was below one drop per minute. Start permissives and low-suction trip passed.

Leakage increased to approximately 18 drops per minute at normal discharge pressure. Confirmed flush line flow and no shaft runout. Pump remained available as standby with daily checks while seal replacement was scheduled for the outage window.

maintenance.summary: Replaced cartridge seal and laser-aligned motor
maintenance.details: Isolated and drained the pump, replaced the cartridge seal and coupling insert, flushed the seal line, and laser-aligned the motor to 0.03 mm offset and 0.04 mm/100 mm angular. A 60-minute loaded run showed no visible leakage and 1.9 mm/s RMS vibration.

maintenance.summary: Verified pump performance after seal repair
maintenance.details: Ran the pump at three operating points and compared results with the acceptance curve. At 42 m3/hour, discharge pressure was 11.4 bar and motor current was 49.8 A. No seal leakage or cavitation was observed; standby status was confirmed.

machines.name: Customer Test Stand (ACME)
machines.description: End-of-line functional acceptance stand installed at ACME Manufacturing for 24 V control assemblies. The cell validates 64 digital I/O points, eight analog channels, safety-loop response, and serialized test results at up to 18 units/hour. Commissioned 2024-05-20; owner: Field Service; criticality: Customer Production; calibration cadence: annual with quarterly remote health review. ACME controls site access and lockout; EQUA support owns software and calibration baselines.
machines.location: ACME Manufacturing / Austin, TX / Quality Lab / Cell A-01

installed_parts.notes: Controller PLC-01; approved program checksum 8F4C-21A7; backup held by Field Service.
Modules DAQ-01 and DAQ-02; channels 1-24 used, channels 25-32 reserved.
Safety relay SR-01; proof-test interval 12 months.
Scanner BC-01; reads unit serial and selects the released test recipe.
Power supply PS-01; output baseline 24.18 VDC at 8.2 A production load.

maintenance.summary: Annual calibration and safety proof test
maintenance.details: Calibrated 16 analog channels against traceable voltage and current standards; maximum as-found error was 0.31%. Verified all 64 digital points, emergency-stop channels, guard switch, and safety relay response. Certificate CAL-TS200-2025-041 was issued.

maintenance.summary: Remote troubleshooting for intermittent false failures
maintenance.details: Review of 312 test logs isolated 17 false failures to contact bounce on fixture input DI-27. Increased the validated debounce from 20 ms to 45 ms, issued recipe version 3.8.2, and monitored the next 150 units with zero repeat failures.

The relay reported a channel synchronization fault during startup. ACME isolated the cell before Field Service replaced SR-01, verified dual-channel timing, and completed 30 emergency-stop and guard-open cycles. Total customer downtime was 2.3 hours.

maintenance.summary: Validated test recipe 3.9.0 for product revision C
maintenance.details: Added two analog tolerance checks and a barcode rule for revision C assemblies. Completed gauge repeatability testing with ten units and three operators; study variation was 6.8%. Released recipe 3.9.0 and archived the prior baseline.

machines.name: Electronics Test Bench 1
machines.description: Engineering bench used for board bring-up, fault injection, and post-repair verification. Supports 0-60 VDC at 20 A, isolated communications, programmable loads, and two grounded ESD work positions. Commissioned 2023-09-18; owner: Engineering Lab; criticality: Medium; calibration cadence: annual for power and measurement instruments with monthly ESD checks. Bench configuration baseline is LAB-E01-R4.
machines.location: Plant A / Engineering Lab / Bench E-01

installed_parts.notes: Primary controller interface in fixture slot A; firmware baseline 2.6.1.
Sensor and communications interface in fixture slot B.
Fault-injection board in fixture slot C; inspect relay contacts every 5,000 cycles.
Configurable I/O interface in fixture slot D; loaded with lab image 4.2.
Supply PS-E01; calibration sticker CAL-2026-011; due 2027-01-22.
Monitor ESD-E01 covers both operator positions and the common work surface.

maintenance.details: Tested both wrist-strap channels, the common point ground, and dissipative work surface. Point-to-ground resistance measured 3.2 and 3.5 Mohm at the two operator positions. Replaced one damaged coil cord and recorded passing results in ESD log E01.

Verified voltage and current output at 10%, 50%, and 100% of range using traceable standards. Maximum voltage error was 0.042% and maximum current error was 0.061%. Adjusted remote-sense compensation and applied calibration label CAL-2026-011.

maintenance.summary: Replaced fixture harness and verified channel map
maintenance.details: Intermittent continuity on harness J4 caused false open-circuit results. Replaced the 48-way harness, performed point-to-point verification, insulation-tested at 250 VDC, and passed the golden-board sequence 25 consecutive times.

maintenance.summary: Updated diagnostic image and fixture baselines
maintenance.details: Updated the bench controller to diagnostic image 4.2, TB1 firmware to 2.6.1, and archived prior checksums. Revalidated voltage, communications, relay, and fault-injection sequences against three golden boards with no deviations.
